mapper.update: update users set name = #{name}, email = #{email} where user_id = #{userId} and del_yn = 'N'

mapper.select: SELECT user_id, login_id, password, name, birth_date, gender, email, del_yn FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND del_yn = 'N'
